summary: Join our expert-led training course on impact evaluation of projects and programs. Gain essential skills to measure effectiveness and drive successful outcomes.
lede: Impact evaluation training helps monitoring and evaluation professionals assess whether observed project changes can be attributed to an intervention rather than external factors. It develops practical skills in mapping causal pathways with a Theory of Change, choosing randomized or quasi-experimental designs, defining measurable indicators, and combining survey data with qualitative findings to produce clear evaluation reports.
audienceIntro: This course is tailored for professionals responsible for measuring, analyzing, and reporting the true outcomes of organizational interventions.
modules: Impact Evaluation Foundations and Causal Logic
Experimental Designs and Randomized Controlled Trials
Digital Data Collection and Field Protocols
prerequisites: Participants should have a foundational understanding of project management or basic monitoring and evaluation concepts. Familiarity with basic statistics and data collection processes is beneficial but not strictly required. No advanced coding or econometric programming experience is necessary, as statistical concepts will be taught at an applied, operational level.
